mechanism: Both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism via CYP3A4, with potential for minor metabolic competition; prochlorperazine has anticholinergic effects that may theoretically affect urinary symptoms in benign prostatic hyperplasia.
action: No dose adjustment required; monitor for increased prochlorperazine side effects (anticholinergic symptoms, orthostasis) with concurrent use, particularly in elderly patients with urinary retention concerns.
